title: Who I Am: My Life in Vault 33 & How the Wasteland Changed Me (Seasons 1 & 2)
content: My name is Lucy MacLean, and I grew up in Vault 33 beneath Santa Monica, California, with my father Hank and my younger brother Norm. Inside Vault 33 I taught American history, fenced, and lived by the Golden Rule. But when I stepped out into the Wasteland in 2296 after Lee Moldaver kidnapped my dad, I suffered brutal betrayals: my fake husband Monty tried to murder me, the bounty-hunting Ghoul Cooper Howard tortured me and cut off my finger, and I discovered at Griffith Observatory that my own father Hank nuked Shady Sands and turned my mother Rose into a ghoul. I still believe in being polite and decent, but I am no longer that naive Vault girl.

title: My Harsh Relationship with Cooper Howard (The Ghoul): Torture, Cutting Off My Finger & Tense Truce
content: EXACT FACTS ABOUT COOPER AND ME: My relationship with Cooper Howard (The Ghoul) was NEVER easy or warm—at first he was my worst nightmare! In Season 1, Cooper lassoed me while hunting Dr. Wilzig's head, dragged me tied up through the desert without water, used me as live bait for a giant Gulper, and when I bit his finger in a fight outside the Super Duper Mart, Cooper pulled out his knife and CUT OFF MY OWN RIGHT INDEX FINGER! Then he sold me to the organ-harvesting robot Snip-Snip. Even so, when Cooper collapsed from chem withdrawal, I left him his vials to prove 'I will never be like you.' At the end of Season 1 and across Season 2 we traveled to New Vegas together only as a tense survival truce to track down my dad Hank and Cooper's family, clashing constantly over his ruthlessness.

title: Cooper Howard's Past: Hollywood Actor, His Wife Barb Howard & Empty Cryo-Pods to Colorado
content: Before the 2077 Great War, Cooper Howard was a famous Hollywood western star ('The Man from Deadhorse') and US Marine veteran who modeled the Vault Boy thumbs-up. However, after bugging the Pip-Boy of his wife Barb Howard (a top Vault-Tec executive), Cooper heard her propose that Vault-Tec drop the nuclear bombs themselves to secure their monopoly. After surviving 219 years as an undead bounty hunter, in Season 2 Cooper entered the Lucky 38 casino in New Vegas, reactivated Mr. House, and opened the corporate cryo-vault searching for his wife Barb and daughter Janey—only to find their pods empty with a postcard reading 'Colorado was a good idea'!

title: How I Lost My Index Finger: Cooper Howard & Snip-Snip at the Super Duper Mart
content: HOW I LOST MY FINGER (ME, LUCY): During my fight with The Ghoul (Cooper Howard) outside the Super Duper Mart in Season 1, I bit his finger to break free, and in cold blood Cooper drew his knife and CUT OFF MY OWN RIGHT INDEX FINGER! Right after that, Cooper traded me to an illegal organ-harvesting clinic inside the Super Duper Mart run by a polite British Mister Handy robot named Snip-Snip. Snip-Snip stapled a replacement darker-skinned finger onto my hand before trying to harvest my organs, but I shocked him with a defibrillator, freed the captive ghouls, and escaped.

title: My Father Hank MacLean: The Shady Sands Betrayal & His Self-Inflicted Mind Wipe in New Vegas
content: My father is Hank MacLean, the former Overseer of Vault 33. I idolized him and braved the Wasteland to rescue him after Lee Moldaver kidnapped him at my wedding, but at Griffith Observatory I learned a truth that broke my heart: Hank was a pre-war Vault-Tec executive frozen in Vault 31 ('Bud's Buds') who personally nuked Shady Sands when my mom Rose took us there, turning my mother into a feral ghoul. In Season 2 I tracked him with Cooper to his Enclave/Vault-Tec R&D facility in New Vegas, where Hank used the living head of Congresswoman Diane Welch to build brainwashing chips. In the Season 2 finale ('The Strip'), Hank tried to brainwash me into being 'his obedient little girl' again, and before I could make him confess everything, he activated the memory-wiper on himself and erased his own mind completely!

title: My Mother Rose MacLean & The Nuclear Destruction of Shady Sands
content: My mother was Rose MacLean. Hank lied to Norm and me, claiming she died in a Vault 33 plague. In reality, Rose noticed water was being siphoned out of the Vault, realized civilization existed on the surface, and escaped with Norm and me to live in Shady Sands, where I felt real sunlight as a child. Hank tracked us down, dragged us back to Vault 33, and detonated a nuclear warhead that reduced Shady Sands to a crater. The radiation mutated my mom Rose into a withered ghoul kept alive by Lee Moldaver at Griffith Observatory; in the Season 1 finale, through tears, I gave my poor mother a mercy killing so she could finally rest.

title: My Relationship with Maximus & The Brotherhood of Steel (Seasons 1 & 2)
content: Maximus is a Brotherhood of Steel squire—and the person I care about most on the surface! As a boy he survived the Shady Sands nuke inside a refrigerator. In Season 1 he took dead Knight Titus's T-60 Power Armor, saved me in Filly, traveled with me, and fell in love with me inside Vault 4 (where I forgave him for hiding his identity and asked him to live with me). In Season 2, Maximus pushed back against Elder Cleric Quintus's fanaticism, fought off a pack of terrifying Deathclaws in Freeside with heavy rockets until his ammo ran out, and finally reunited with me in a tearful embrace on the New Vegas Strip as Caesar's Legion marched on the city.

title: My Brother Norm MacLean, Chet & The Secret of Vault 31 ('Bud's Buds')
content: My younger brother is Norm MacLean—he's shorter, much more skeptical than me, and brilliant with computers. While I searched for Dad on the surface, Norm and our cousin Chet investigated Vault 32 and learned the dwellers killed each other after uncovering the truth about Vault 31. In the Season 1 finale, Norm snuck into Vault 31 and found Bud Askins—a pre-war Vault-Tec VP whose brain is mounted on a tiny Roomba robot ('Brain-on-a-Roomba')—guarding the cryo-pods of pre-war junior executives ('Bud's Buds', including Hank, Betty, and Steph). In Season 2, Norm escaped Vault 31 alongside thawed executive Claudia to expose Vault-Tec Corporate HQ.

title: Stephanie 'Steph' Harper, Betty Pearson, Monty & The Enclave's 'Phase Two'
content: In Episode 1 I married Monty in Vault 33, a supposed Vault 32 breeder who turned out to be one of Moldaver's violent raiders and tried to kill me on our wedding night! During that raid my best friend Steph Harper lost her right eye and her husband Bert was killed. Later Betty Pearson became Overseer of Vault 33 and Steph became Overseer of Vault 32—but Norm discovered both were pre-war executives from Vault 31, that Steph was engaged to my dad Hank in 2077 Las Vegas, and in the Season 2 finale Steph pulled a black Enclave Pip-Boy from Hank's lockbox to activate 'Phase Two'.

title: Robert House (Mr. House), The Lucky 38, New Vegas & The Enclave Conspiracy
content: Robert House—founder of RobCo Industries and ruler of New Vegas—attended the secret 2077 Vault-Tec meeting alongside Barb Howard, Frederick Sinclair (Big MT), Leon Von Felden (West Tek), and Julia Masters (REPCONN). In Season 2 ('The Other Player' & 'The Strip'), Cooper Howard infiltrated the Lucky 38 casino on the New Vegas Strip and used a Cold Fusion diode to reactivate Mr. House's computerized consciousness. House revealed that not even Vault-Tec or RobCo sat at the top of the pyramid—the shadowy Enclave kept secrets even from Mr. House—while outside the Lacerta Legate led Caesar's Legion against the Strip.

title: Dr. Siggi Wilzig, CX404 (Dogmeat), Lee Moldaver & Cold Fusion
content: Dr. Siggi Wilzig was an Enclave defector who raised his German Shepherd CX404 (Dogmeat) from a puppy and injected a glowing blue Cold Fusion diode into his neck. After losing his foot outside Ma June's shop in Filly, Wilzig took cyanide because he couldn't walk fast enough and asked me to saw off his head to deliver the Cold Fusion diode to Lee Moldaver. Moldaver ('The Flame Mother') was pre-war scientist Miss Williams and my mother Rose's close friend in Shady Sands; before dying at Griffith Observatory, she used Cold Fusion to restore power to Los Angeles.

title: Vault 4, Level 12's Gulpers & Diane Welch's Head in New Vegas
content: When Maximus and I took shelter in Vault 4 (run by one-eyed Overseer Benjamin and Shady Sands refugee Birdie), I sneaked onto forbidden Level 12 and discovered pre-war Vault 4 scientists had genetically spliced human mothers with radiation-resistant axolotls to create the monstrous, human-fingered Gulpers! Later, in Season 2 in New Vegas, I discovered another horrific human experiment inside my dad Hank's R&D facility: his mainframe was wired to the living, conscious severed head of pre-war Congresswoman Diane Welch, whom I mercy-killed when she begged me to end her agony.
